title: Sindhu, Unnati Advance to Asian Games Quarterfinals
indian_angle: This story highlights the progress of two prominent Indian women's singles players at a major continental event.
summary: P.V. Sindhu and Unnati Hooda have successfully advanced to the quarterfinals of the Asian Games, keeping India's medal hopes alive in women's singles.

title: Satwik-Chirag Suffer Shock First Round Exit
indian_angle: This reports a significant upset for India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, at an international tournament.
summary: India's world No. 5 men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, were surprisingly defeated in the first round by Thailand's Pakkapon Teeraratsakul and Peeratchai Sukphun.

title: Junior National Camp Underway for World Championships
indian_angle: This news details the preparation of India's promising junior badminton players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing India's young talent.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This highlights BAI's efforts in developing coaching talent within India, crucial for nurturing future players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, running from September 14th to 23rd.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This signifies a major rule change in domestic junior tournaments, impacting how young Indian players compete and develop.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
